correctness.rationale: All eight template forms are proven absent; deleting any single character gives an embedded word. Each arbitrary absent word is exhausted by its alternating-run count (one, two, three, or four or more), where explicit necessary-and-sufficient embedding conditions force a template subsequence. This establishes the exact antichain. The length polynomial follows from pairwise distinct templates, and the fixed-length multiplicities follow from compositions. Independent direct-set enumeration matched all 256 quadruples with run lengths 1..4; 625 larger witness checks and n=4..40 composition checks passed. The universal argument is the written case proof, not the finite tests.

value.rationale: Minimal absent scattered subsequences form the canonical antichain basis for the complement of a subsequence ideal. Arbitrarily long four-run strings admit a basis of at most eight explicit words, with a sharp interior-run threshold determining whether the cardinality is 5, 6 or 8. The formula determines every missing-pattern obstruction, its exact length spectrum, and its finite-length distribution; this is a motivated complete family classification, not merely a small-instance computation or a rename of a known universal counting result.
